name: Google Ads
description: Google's advertising platform; the Google Ads API manages campaigns, budgets, keywords and reporting via GAQL.
access_notes: Signup is self-serve but production is gated by developer-token access levels: a new token gets Test Account Access (test accounts only, 15k ops/day); many tokens are auto-granted Explorer Access (production, but capped at 2,880 ops/day and excluding planning tools, account creation, billing). Basic Access (full features, 15k ops/day) requires an application reviewed by Google (~5 business days); Standard Access (unlimited) is a further review (~10 days). Also requires an OAuth client from Google Cloud plus a manager (MCC) account to hold the developer token.
mcp_notes: Google maintains an official, read-only Google Ads MCP server (github.com/googleads/google-ads-mcp; developer guide on developers.google.com) exposing list_accessible_customers, search (GAQL) and resource-metadata tools; mutations are deliberately excluded. Composio catalog lists a Google Ads toolkit (GOOGLEADS, 22 tools, OAUTH2).
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks=false refers to the core Ads API, which has no push/webhook mechanism (reporting is pull-based); lead form webhook delivery exists as a separate advertiser feature. The mandatory developer-token header is an extra credential on top of OAuth, not a standalone auth method. Explorer Access auto-grant means limited production reads may work without review, but full production capability requires Basic Access approval.

evidence.note: Table of Test Account / Explorer / Basic / Standard access levels: Basic requires application with ~5 business day review; new tokens start at Test Account Access.
Developer token from a Google Ads manager account API Center; access level controls daily calls and test-vs-production environment.
Quick start: developer token + OAuth credentials; service accounts supported by granting them access to the Google Ads customer account.
Official Google Ads MCP server developer guide: read-only, Python, stdio, OAuth 2.0 or service account auth.
Official googleads GitHub org repo for the MCP server (tools + discovery/metrics/segments resources).
Catalog lists Google Ads toolkit (GOOGLEADS, 22 tools, OAUTH2).
